_comment: SYNTHETIC. The facts below were written by hand from data/sample/transcript_sample.json (fictional company Northwind Logistics) — they are not model output and this event never happened. Shape mirrors the artifact the production summarizer publishes, whose `response.facts` becomes the disclosure item with kind=facts / source=earnings_call.

facts: Total revenue was $842 million, up 14% year over year and above the high end of the $810-825 million guidance range.
Managed Freight revenue grew 31% year over year and rose to 38% of total revenue from 33% a year ago.
Enterprise shippers on the platform reached 4,180 after net additions of 240 in the quarter.
Net revenue retention improved to 118% from 112% in the prior-year quarter.
Gross margin expanded 310 basis points year over year to 27.4%, driven primarily by automated load matching rising to 71% of volume from 54%.
Adjusted EBITDA was $118 million, a 14.0% margin, versus $71 million and a 9.6% margin a year ago.
Adjusted earnings per share was $0.64, up from $0.35 in the prior-year quarter.
Free cash flow was $61 million on $96 million of operating cash flow, after $35 million of capital expenditures tied mainly to two new cross-dock facilities.
The company repurchased 1.9 million shares for $58 million and the board authorized an incremental $300 million buyback against a net cash position of $160 million.
Full-year revenue guidance was raised to $3.38-3.42 billion from $3.28-3.34 billion and adjusted EBITDA guidance to $472-488 million from $430-450 million.
